title: Chapter 105: Triple Kill Boss
content:
Chapter 105: Triple Kill Boss

At this moment, Wang Shuo caught a glimpse of Dongfang Ling.

Just now, the beetle boss had cut the golden armored warrior in half with one bite, and the golden armored warrior that was broken into two pieces was still emitting white smoke.

Looking at the puppet fragments on the ground, this also directly announced that the golden armored warrior who had provided Wang Shuo with huge military support was officially scrapped.

In this way, the beetle boss that no one dealt with became a huge variable.

Just as Wang Shuo was worried, he saw Dongfang Ling move and take over the position of the golden armored warrior and confront the beetle boss.

Dongfang Ling used a long rope prop to tie a beetle boss in place.

Although she could not cause much damage to the beetle boss, at least she had destroyed a boss.

Wang Shuo then remembered that he seemed to have another control skill.

He looked back at the blue-and-white python and activated the "iron chain binding" skill.

This kind of directional skill basically rarely fails.

Seeing the python tied up in place, Wang Shuo shouted loudly: "I need support, all ranged, focus on the python."

"Received, Lord."

Ladul and Li Jianguo, who were in charge of the energy tower, immediately poured all their firepower on the blue-and-white python.

"-1800"

"-600"

Wang Shuo looked at the python struggling violently, and had an ominous premonition in his heart. It seemed that he couldn't tie her up for 10 seconds!

No.

The firepower output must be increased.

He took out 10 more thunder bombs from his backpack and threw them at the python.

"Bang..."

"Bang..."

The explosions continued, and the blue-and-white python was covered with wounds, and its health value dropped rapidly.

Another bronze spear pierced her head, and the blue-and-white python's health value was immediately reset to zero.

[Your subordinate Li Jianguo killed the level 21 bronze boss, Blue and White Python (ID: Snake 10217 Yunina]

At this point, the third bronze boss fell.

Wang Shuo was in a good mood. Three had already fallen. How far would the fourth be?

Seeing the items bursting on the ground, Wang Shuo thought it was better to pick them up first. In case there were things that could be used immediately, it would also enhance the combat power.

[Giant Python Gallbladder +1, Advanced Venom Fang +2, Energy Crystal +100, Soul Crystal +3]

[Giant Python Gallbladder: After taking it, it provides all attributes +2.]

Wang Shuo ate it immediately, and he also took one of the 5 Agility Enhancement Pills he had received before.

Now he can't miss it if he can enhance his strength even a little bit.

With Then he picked up the items dropped by the wild antelope.

[Antelope horn +2, advanced storage backpack (antelope stomach) +1, energy crystal +100, soul crystal +2]

[Advanced storage backpack (antelope stomach): provides 10,000 grids of backpack space. ]

Antelope horns and advanced fangs are both advanced materials. They seem to be used to make special equipment. Their uses are not yet known.

After collecting the items, Wang Shuo quickly joined other battles.

…

A few minutes ago, when the outer wall collapsed.

Fang Kai and others also became nervous.

"If we don't save people, I'm afraid it will be too late." Zhang Jinsheng was as anxious as an ant on a hot pot, constantly urging Fang Kai.

The main reason was that among the four people, Fang Kai's The strongest, although his level is not as high as Xie Fan's 26th level.

But he has high qualifications, and he has changed his job to a military general, and his attributes have been enhanced again.

Wait a little longer, Fang Kai is patient.

Fang Kai, Xie Fan and Zhang Jinsheng are both good friends and rivals in love.

Although Fang Kai is Dongfang Ling's guard, his status is not low. His father is the general manager of Qingyang Mansion and holds huge power.

The reason why he is so patient at this moment is mainly because he wants to play a trick of a hero saving a beauty.

Going too early will not achieve the effect, and going too late will be afraid that Dongfang Ling will be in trouble.

Fang Kai's heart is also very nervous.

And Xie Fan and Zhang Jinsheng are similar, holding the same idea.

Only Xu Qing is really anxious, but what Use it!

How could she not know the thoughts of these three men? They were always scheming against each other and sabotaging each other.

Now that they were together, it was good enough that they didn't fight.

"If we don't go now, it might be too late!" Xu Qing stamped her feet anxiously.

"Okay, let's go, save the people and leave, don't fight."

After Fang Kai finished speaking, he swung his right arm, and a long sword suddenly appeared in his hand. The silver-white sword flashed with dazzling light.

Then he moved his body, leaving a residual image on the spot, and he was already ten meters away.

Zhang Jinsheng also touched his bright forehead, took out a golden long stick from his backpack, and laughed: "We'll catch up soon."

Xu Qing and Xie Fan did not hesitate at all and quickly followed.
